rendererChange.scope: listening tokens branch only (1 of 4 inline copies of the spacing rule)

hyphenPolicy: hyphenated units are split into segments so each resolvable part keeps its own span and popup; a unit stays merged only when the merged form resolves and no segment does (Mün-chen). Letter-by-letter spellings stay plain. Spacing is preserved with noSpaceAfter flags.
